summary: Deutsche Bank AG filed a routine Form 6-K for September 2026 (period ended 2026-09-30) furnishing Exhibit 99.1, 'Key updates communicated during 3Q 2026,' prepared under EU IFRS with the EU carve-out for fair value hedge accounting. The report is incorporated by reference into Registration Statement No. 333-278331. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer update, not a special situation; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
